name: Greg Lindqvist
summary: Staff engineer with fifteen years building and running distributed systems on the JVM. I lead architecture across teams, mentor senior engineers and like deleting more code than I write.

experience.title: Staff Software Engineer
bullets: Led the architecture of the order-orchestration platform that now processes 2.1M orders a day across 14 services.
Cut AWS spend by $1.4M a year by moving batch workloads to spot capacity and retiring three idle clusters.
Designed the event schema and replay tooling that let teams rebuild any service from the Kafka log; incident recovery time fell from hours to minutes.
Mentored 9 engineers, 4 of whom were promoted to senior in two years.
Wrote the company's architecture decision record process; over 120 ADRs filed since.
Interview loop owner for senior backend hires; ran about 60 interviews.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Rebuilt the shipment tracking service in Java to handle 50x the event volume of the old system.
Introduced Cassandra for the tracking store and ran the migration with zero downtime.
Led a team of 5 through a move from a monolith to services on AWS.
Built the on-call runbooks and trained the team on them.
Reduced p95 API latency from 900ms to 210ms through query tuning and caching.
Code reviews, design reviews, and so on.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Developed the billing engine in Java used by 40 hospital customers.
Wrote an internal job scheduler used by other teams.
Fixed a memory leak that caused weekly restarts.
Worked on the PostgreSQL schema and reporting queries.
Participated in the on-call rotation.

experience.title: Junior Developer
bullets: Built internal tools and small websites for clients.
Responsible for bug fixes and testing.
Helped with deployments.
Supported the helpdesk when needed.
